After fixture HEAD advanced to bd7fc88dc72e, fresh session 2334abac-f346-4a7e-b909-0d6466d89d81 rejected the old checkpoint. CLI recorded zero spawned children; first.txt was not reread and the pending task did not run.

limitations: The old native worker handle was not recovered. The resumed tool surface did not expose TaskOutput, and the driver had already observed the orphan process exit before pickup. This establishes checkpoint recovery, not live-worker reattachment.
The read-only old worker survived coordinator SIGKILL for a bounded period. Writer recovery must confirm old work is terminal or isolate generations before replacement.
Unit B was newly dispatched; unit A was inherited from the validated checkpoint. The old B attempt had no accepted terminal result.
